allowed_material_actually_used: eight native-size IIIF crops of the same image, one rotated 180 degrees, with explicit receipts
method.other_material: No other research, transcription, score, previous interpretation or manuscript commentary was opened. Directory names were listed to locate the allowed input; their files were not read.
method.visual_only: No OCR, transcription, language identification, symbolic decoding, semantic interpretation or text-to-image correlation.
method.whole_canvas_view: The image viewer reported a display reduction from 4972x3738 to 3660x2751 for the first whole-canvas view. Original file was unchanged. All detail boxes are estimates transferred from native-size crop coordinates.
method.coordinate_system: Original full-image pixels; origin at top left; x increases right, y increases down. Boxes are [left,top,right,bottom], approximate enclosing windows, not pixel-perfect masks. Usual uncertainty is about 15-35 px; weak traces may be uncertain by 50-90 px. Overlapping boxes are intentional.
method.group_definition: A writing zone is a spatially separated run or local block of ink marks, not a word. Coarse zones can contain multiple visibly separated runs. Counts explicitly depend on this grouping level. Writing-like versus ornament-like is only a visual classification.
method.sector_definition: S01 starts immediately clockwise of the upper near-vertical separator B00, then S02...S12 proceed clockwise. Start is a geometric boundary, not a textual starting point. Sectors are unequal and some boundaries are partial.
method.blinding_limit: Original writing is visible, and observer pretraining is unknown. This is not strict blinding or expert certification.
method.selection_rule: All regions of the right diagram, uncertain partitions, and bottom prose retained. No candidate scoring or exclusion of ambiguous areas.

whole_canvas_inventory.description: Full photographed open surface, with black surroundings, a vertical gutter near x=2500, and binding structures at far left.

Large left circular diagram, partly close to gutter; contains one large central face-like drawing and many outward pointed and line compartments. Context only; no detailed count requested for this diagram.
Four approximately horizontal lines of writing above the left diagram.
Large right circular diagram; all parts included in detailed inventory below.
Three approximately horizontal writing lines below right circle, middle line red, upper/lower lines pale brown; a horizontal ruled trace lies between middle and lower lines.
Small dark marginal mark near upper edge of left surface; not read.
Small dark marginal marks near bottom of left surface; not read.
Faint marks in upper-right margin; identity and writing status uncertain.

center_motif.description: One multi-pointed central drawing overlapping a scalloped circular ornament and faint blue-green wash. Approximately eight long points can be followed; some narrow outlines overlap. No definite face is visible inside this central drawing.
center_motif.point_count_caveat: Outline overlap and a short upper-left projection make exact contour-based counting definition-dependent.

right_diagram_geometry.ring_count_statement: Five nested circular levels are distinguishable if the small central scalloped ornament and the decorated outer rim are included. Between them are three main thin circular boundary levels. The outermost of those three has a nearby parallel trace in several arcs; this is not counted as an independently verified complete additional circle. Circular arrangements of faces and writing are not themselves extra drawn rings.

ring_levels.description: Small scalloped/rounded ornament behind central pointed drawing. Its edge is partly occluded by pointed shapes.
Thin approximately circular boundary surrounding the central writing field. Faint and discontinuous, especially on the left and lower-left.

Larger faint circle near the twelve small face-like drawings and adjacent inward short writing zones; approximate inner edge of the large sector field. Several radial separators end near this level; local traces and labels overlap.
ring_levels.visibility: uneven; partial lower-left and upper-right traces

ring_levels.description: Main outer limit of sector text field. A second nearby curved trace appears outside it along substantial arcs, particularly upper-left and lower-right. The gap is narrow and irregular, roughly 15-45 px where distinguishable.
ring_levels.kind: sector-field outer boundary with locally doubled contour
ring_levels.visibility: generally visible; faint near gutter; no claim of two fully complete circles

ring_levels.description: Outermost decorated rim of short oblique marks, cross-bar-like groups, pale filled segments and gaps. Red curved writing lies inside this rim and outside R03.
ring_levels.visibility: mostly visible, leftmost sections weak and near gutter

face_count.caveat: These are counts of visible round face-like drawings, not an identification of what they represent. Fill categories do not strictly alternate around the ring.

sector_count.caveat: Twelve is the apparent compartment count including weak B07 and B08. It is not twelve independently confirmed, fully enclosed polygons. Missing/weak boundaries were retained rather than reconstructed as certain.

radial_boundaries.note: Upper near-vertical trace; chosen geometric starting boundary.
Upper-right diagonal; visibility varies across writing field.
Slant from right-upper edge inward; endpoint is close to upper part of I03.
Near-horizontal right boundary; does not continue as a solid line into central ornament.
Lower-right diagonal; begins outside the inward labels.
Lower-right steep diagonal ending near lower face band.
Lower-left diagonal candidate. Short traces can be followed between writing blocks, but no continuous line is established across its whole span; endpoint estimates have larger error.
Left-lower separator candidate. Low contrast, nearby stain and paper texture prevent a secure continuous trace; no confident straight completion is asserted.
Near-horizontal left trace. A nearby physical fold complicates its classification and continuation.
Upper-left diagonal trace ending near inner face/label band.
Steep upper-left trace; endpoint near the inner circle and top-left label band.

outer_sector_writing.row_count_uncertainty: About +/-1 where short rows and separate inward groups can be grouped differently. S09 is especially uncertain because of stain and faint ink.

central_writing.count_statement: Seven coarse spatial writing zones around the central pointed ornament are inventoried. A finer split of sparse lower-left/left zones can yield eight or nine runs. This is a geometric zone inventory, not a word count, and no single exact fine-grained count is asserted.

zones.description: Upper-right of central ornament; one tilted run.
Right-upper side; one steeply rotated run.
Right-lower side; short sparse run with internal gap.
Bottom side; roughly tangential run with tall strokes.
Lower-left side; two sparse clusters along a bent/tangential course. They may be one coarse zone or two fine runs.
Left side; sparse marks in a near-vertical run. A large internal gap permits a two-run segmentation.
Upper-left of central ornament; one short oblique run.

nonwriting_trace.description: Short dotted/segmented oblique trace directed toward central ornament from left-lower side. Not included as a writing zone or as a full radial sector boundary; its role is uncertain.

outer_red_writing.count_statement: Thirteen coarse arc zones are retained here. O03 visibly contains two separated subclusters, so this inventory supports fourteen finer clusters under that split. O09-O12 can also be split differently because of spaces, wear and discontinuity. No unique exact word/phrase or group count is claimed. These zones were NOT forced to equal the sector count.

zones.description: Top arc; several close red clusters.
Upper-right arc; one coarse tilted zone with internal spacing.
Right-upper diagonal arc; two well-separated red subclusters may be counted separately.
Right-upper near-vertical red run.
Right-lower near-vertical red run with internal spaces.
Lower-right diagonal red run.
Lower-right low arc red run.
Bottom red run.
Lower-left low arc red run with a wide internal gap.
Lower-left arc red run, internally fragmented.
Left near-vertical red marks; patchy ink and fold/gutter proximity make joining fragments uncertain.
Upper-left near-vertical/diagonal red marks; discontinuous.
Upper-left long diagonal red run with internal spacing.

bottom_prose.segmentation_rule: One zone per approximately horizontal writing baseline; no word segmentation.

zones.description: Top pale-brown writing line; both ends faint.
Middle red writing line with taller/bolder marks.
Bottom pale-brown writing line; faint ends.
Thin horizontal ruled trace between middle red line and bottom pale line. Some descending red strokes approach or cross this trace; no stroke order inferred.

bottom_prose.caveat: These are prose-like horizontal lines by layout only; their content or linguistic function is not identified.

ambiguity_and_crossing_inventory.description: Brown stain/abrasion over the left-lower sector writing region. Marks continue near its edges; hidden content is not reconstructed.
Horizontal fold/crease and near-horizontal drawn traces are close together on the left side of right diagram. B09 is retained with this confound.
Lower-left boundaries B07 and B08 are weak and partial. Text-block spacing and face placement suggest compartments, but are not a substitute for a continuous drawn line.
B02 inner endpoint is close to a tall stroke at the upper end of I03 and to the faint circular trace. Possible line/letter contact; no reliable over/under order.
Faint R02 circular trace passes close to or through parts of short writing zones and face margins. Local breaks prevent exact containment or overlap assignments.
Faint R01 boundary surrounds central writing, but local marks and dotted D01 complicate the left-lower edge. It is not a certain uninterrupted circle.
Central long points visibly overlap the scalloped ornament and colored wash. The overlap is graphical; layer order is not established.
Left rim and red writing approach the gutter, with faint/fragmented marks and possible physical wear. All fragments remain included in exterior zones.
Nearby parallel outer circular traces are not uniformly separated. A strict count of drawn circles depends on whether local doubled traces are treated as independent circles.
Red descenders and horizontal rule approach/overlap near bottom prose; no reading direction or chronology is inferred.

count_summary.outer_sector_rows: Usually 2-3 in each block; some separate short groups are listed independently. No exact aggregate row count is certified.
count_summary.caveat: All counts are independent visual inventories at stated granularity. They are not word counts, identities, meanings, or evidence of semantic matching among rings.

limitations: Single photograph, no physical object examination.
Manual visual approximate boxes, not segmentation masks.
Some faint lines may be guide traces, paper features, or interrupted boundaries; roles retained as uncertain.
Writing zone segmentation depends on spatial grouping and cannot certify words or phrases.
No expert certification or strict blinding.
No conclusions about manuscript meaning, language, named entities, chronology, or correspondence between written groups.
